BiblicalUsage: Paarai the Arbite, son of Ezbai, is named among David's mighty men in the roll of the thirty-seven. His name means gaping, and apart from this single mention Scripture tells us nothing more about him.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God keeps the names of His servants even when their stories are lost to us: one verse is enough for Him to remember Paarai forever.
